summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist, exported it explicitly from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection with an autofunction entry to docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities automodule, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). No commits were made, and no tests, scripts, or installs were run, so the tests and Black formatting are unverified. Line lengths were checked and none exceed 120. Choices: typing is imported for type hints, and a non-list value under the data_list_key raises ValueError.
